proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics catalog_ref creature source
proposed_widenings.justification: The item fits the existing magic_item spawned_creature family, but that family currently requires an inline stat block. This item instead summons an existing named monster stat block, so a catalog-reference payload is needed to avoid fabricating stats.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental"

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureDismissal.manualDismiss = bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The dismissal surface only allows magic_action or never, but this item explicitly allows dismissing the companion as a Bonus Action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action."
